nights.title: Overmono: Pure Devotion - World Tour
nights.name: Overmono
nights.extract: Overmono is a Welsh electronic music duo consisting of the brothers Tom and Ed Russell.

nights.title: I Muvrini
nights.name: I Muvrini
nights.description: Folk music group from Corsica, France
nights.extract: I Muvrini is a Corsican folk music group, who sing traditional Corsican music (Polyphony) in their native Corsican language.

nights.title: The Last Internationale
nights.name: The Last Internationale
nights.extract: The Last Internationale (TLI) is an American rock band formed by New York City guitarist Edgey Pires and vocalist Delila Paz.
